statement: Every open loop-group orbit whose closed restricted operator image has dimension two admits an equivariant based null-homotopy on its entire closure. The resulting closure contractions agree on all overlaps, are transported exactly by the original operator group, and glue continuously with continuous inverse on each finite union of these closures.
depends_on: C.30 free proper closed operator images; C.33 dimension-two simple transitivity and right-translation centralizer; C.32 ambient-null restriction; Gomez--Pinedo--Uzcategui 2017 Theorem 3.5 for the actual open Polish quotient homomorphism; C.28 intrinsic compact arcs; explicit two-dimensional Lie-algebra classification and affine exponential; covering-lift uniqueness and Lie-homomorphism naturality
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; frontier-compatible dimension-two operator closures in the C.12 proof route
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The action on the closure is factored through the actual open restriction homomorphism L to N_O, whose kernel fixes that closure pointwise. Every N_O element has a preimage in the original G, so its boundary action preserves the original G-orbits without assuming that closure(G) preserves arbitrary original orbits.
notes: L is the closure of the generated group in the plane homeomorphism group. Its surjection onto the simply transitive two-dimensional Lie centralizer is open, giving a continuous factored closure action without a section. The based restriction loop has a closed universal-cover lift; exp((1-s)log) contracts it. Shared nontrivial boundary images are identified, with their actual intrinsic compact-open topology, as R-translations, S1-rotations or the positive affine group. Their quotient homomorphisms have unique based lifts and intertwine the globally bijective exponentials, proving equality of the closure contractions on every overlap. Finite closed-set pasting proves joint continuity and inverse continuity on finite unions. C37 subsequently gives a uniform three-word estimate and continuous contraction with inverses on X2, the closed union of all these open orbits, including infinite accumulation. Extension across X2 to its exterior, including dimension-zero/one proper operator frontiers and compatible choices on the remaining nonopen locus, remains required in C12.
